narrow_admission_compatibility: An existing init container may retain its exact original mount sequence or append the single standard read-only ServiceAccount mount from the same runtime extra projected volume used by the main container.
The extra volume must have the standard kube-api-access prefix, one serviceAccountToken projection at path token, and no false automount flag; token contents are never read.
An init container already mounting the standard ServiceAccount path cannot receive another such mount.
Only an explicitly declared matchLabelKeys pod-template-hash may add one exact In expression for that Pod's own hash.
Pod, ReplicaSet metadata, ReplicaSet template and ReplicaSet selector hash labels must all agree.
All other init fields, original selector fields, counts, order, image, commands and environment remain exact comparisons.
